title: Aerated Croatian Burger Buns Burger
description: A rich, aerated burger featuring sesame seed buns, perfect for a lazy Sunday evening. This dish combines traditional Croatian flavors with modern plant-based friendliness.

ingredients.name: Fresh yeast
ingredients.notes: active dry yeast works as well

instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a bowl, let it sit for 5 minutes to activate the yeast.
Add flour, salt, and sugar to the bowl, mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces, shape each piece into a ball.
Let the dough balls rest for 10 minutes, then roll each one into a long rope, forming the classic burger bun shape.
Place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, cover with plastic wrap, and let them rise for another 30 minutes, or until puffed.
Bake the buns in a preheated oven at 350°F (180°C) for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the buns are baking, cook your favorite burger patties, following the package instructions.

Assemble the burgers by spreading a dollop of mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a few slices of fresh lettuce, a slice of tomato, and finally the top bun, securing with a toothpick if needed.
